name: CAMILLE BERNARD
headline: Operating Theatre Nurse | 8+ Years in Nursing

experience.title: Operating Theatre Nurse
bullets: Grew the team by 24% in two years while keeping attrition below 12%
Introduced weekly operating reviews that cut decision turnaround from 16 days to 1 day
Represented the function in executive steering committees and board-level reporting
Mentored 5 junior colleagues, several of whom were promoted within 18 months
Partnered with senior leadership to define the annual roadmap and a budget of €16.2M
Led a team of 7 across 10 workstreams, owning hiring, performance reviews and quarterly planning

experience.title: Registered Nurse
bullets: Participated in 14 code blue as a responses certified ACLS provider
Coordinated with physicians and allied health teams during daily multidisciplinary rounds
Oversaw duty rosters for 5 nurses and managed ward inventory and consumables
Triaged 200+ patients monthly in the emergency department using the Manchester Triage System
Trained 5 newly joined nurses on medication safety and documentation in Electronic Medical Records
Maintained 100% compliance in JCI/ NABH accreditation audits for the unit
Implemented a fall-prevention bundle that reduced patient falls by 26%

experience.title: Junior Staff Nurse
bullets: Educated patients and families on discharge plans, cutting 30-day readmissions by 10%
Provided direct care to 24 patients per shift in a 6-bed medical-surgical ward
Reduced hospital-acquired infection rates by 60% by leading hand-hygiene audits
Managed ventilated patients in a 18-bed ICU, titrating vasoactive infusions per protocol
